abilities.name: Second Helping
abilities.description: When you finish a physical task, you can do it again a little faster and steadier, as long as you start within a minute.
abilities.cost: Hands shake for a few minutes after the second attempt

growth.grows: how many tasks it can repeat and how much better the repeat is

abilities.name: Scrap Absorption
abilities.description: Hold a broken object for ten breaths to learn one useful property of its material, then forget it at dawn.
abilities.cost: Palms sting and redden for an hour

growth.grows: how many properties it keeps and how long they last

abilities.name: Margin Notes
abilities.description: After losing a fight or argument, recall the one mistake that lost it, clearly enough to avoid it next time.
abilities.cost: Only works after a real loss; a sleepless night follows

growth.grows: how many mistakes it shows and how soon after the loss

abilities.name: Borrowed Stance
abilities.description: You can copy one stance or grip you watched someone use today and hold it for a single exchange of blows.
abilities.cost: The copied muscles cramp for the rest of the scene

growth.grows: how long the copy holds and how many moves it takes

abilities.name: Stubborn Ember
abilities.description: Keep one small fire burning through wind and rain for an hour by feeding it a drop of your own sweat.
abilities.cost: Thirsty and lightheaded until you drink

growth.grows: the size of the fire and what it refuses to let go out

abilities.name: Grudge Ledger
abilities.description: Name someone who wronged you; for a day you notice when they are within a street of you.
abilities.cost: One name at a time; the anger keeps you from resting easy

growth.grows: how far away and how many names it can hold

abilities.name: Pocket Hour
abilities.description: Hide one hand-sized item somewhere only you can reach by touching an empty pocket, for up to an hour.
abilities.cost: Lose track of the time while the item is hidden

growth.grows: the size of the item and how long it stays hidden

abilities.name: Odd Job Instinct
abilities.description: Touch a tool you have never used and know how to hold it and do one basic job with it.
abilities.cost: The knowledge fades after the job is done

growth.grows: how skilled the borrowed use is and how long it stays

abilities.name: Slow Bruise
abilities.description: Let a blow land and spread its pain over the next hour instead of all at once, so you can keep moving now.
abilities.cost: The full pain arrives later and keeps you from sleeping

growth.grows: how hard a blow it can spread and how long it delays

abilities.name: Small Luck Coin
abilities.description: Flip a coin before a choice; on heads the next small risk goes your way, on tails nothing happens.
abilities.cost: The coin is lost on a third tails in a day

growth.grows: how big a risk it can tip

abilities.name: Stair Counter
abilities.description: Count steps aloud as you walk and you can later retrace any path you counted, even in the dark.
abilities.cost: Losing count breaks the path; you must start over

growth.grows: how long a path it remembers and how many at once

abilities.name: Late Bloom
abilities.description: After a minute of quiet breathing, retry a check you just failed with a fresh mind.
abilities.cost: Once per day; a dull headache for the rest of the day

growth.grows: how many retries and how soon after the failure
